name: NuBlox Developer Handoff Pack

product.governing_security_rule: Career != Organisation Role != Project Role != Permission

authentication_and_tenancy.tenant_authority: active NuBlox user + active organisation_members row
authentication_and_tenancy.selected_organisation_cookie: selection hint only; server revalidates membership
authentication_and_tenancy.signup_policy: fail-closed; exactly one valid invitation or organisation-bootstrap intent
authentication_and_tenancy.foreign_record_policy: tenant-owned foreign public IDs are masked where disclosure would leak tenant identity

permission_model.umbrella_policy: resolve granular key first; same-domain umbrella applies only when granular has no explicit member/role decision; explicit granular deny cannot be bypassed
permission_model.cross_domain_policy: permission umbrellas never cross domain families

standard_roles.bootstrap_parity: Existing-tenant forward-migration grants and future OrganisationBootstrapService grants are persisted and integration-tested for released finance authority families.

implemented_workflow: Controlled Reminder Dispatch and Retry Evidence

authoritative_position.invoice_outstanding_formula: issued invoice gross - issued credit-note gross - active payment allocations - active write-offs
authoritative_position.customer_position: sum positive outstanding issued invoices per customer/currency
authoritative_position.void_policy: voided invoices contribute no receivable exposure
authoritative_position.unallocated_cash_policy: unallocated cash does not reduce customer receivable until allocated
authoritative_position.write_off_policy: only active authorised write-offs reduce receivable; reversal restores the amount

payment_capacity.formula: payment amount - active invoice allocations - active bad-debt recoveries
payment_capacity.reversal_policy: a payment with active bad-debt recovery usage cannot be reversed until recovery is explicitly reversed

tax_configuration.provisioning_policy: idempotent; matching tenant categories and existing rate history are preserved
tax_configuration.invoice_line_policy: invoice draft lines require explicit tax selection and issue refreshes the selected category against the issue-date effective rate
tax_configuration.deliberate_non_claim: construction domestic reverse-charge invoice treatment is not represented as ordinary 0% tax

receivables_reporting.persistence_policy: no customer-statement, statement-line, aging-balance or editable balance tables
receivables_reporting.write_off_history: write-off authorisation is a statement credit; write-off reversal is a statement debit; aging subtracts write-offs active at the cutoff; recovery is not a customer receivable movement

controlled_collections.accounting_boundary: collection cases/actions/promises/disputes never become a receivable, settlement or aging ledger

collections_automation.scheduler_policy: no cron scheduler, durable worker or background automatic generation/dispatch is claimed

credit_control.current_receivable_formula: sum positive issued invoice outstanding after credits, allocations and active write-offs
credit_control.limit_block_rule: projected exposure > enabled credit limit; exact equality is allowed
credit_control.hold_block_rule: active customer hold blocks named new-commitment boundaries regardless of currency/amount
credit_control.serialization: customer-first invoice locking and current/locking receivable reads prevent concurrent invoice issue or write-off mutation from racing a commitment decision
credit_control.persistence_policy: no mutable used-credit, available-credit, reserved-headroom or shadow receivable balance

bad_debt.name: Controlled Bad Debt, Write-off and Recovery

standard_role_defaults.Finance/Commercial: view + case.manage + recommend + recovery.record + recovery.reverse; no write-off authorise/reverse

invariants: bad-debt case is exact tenant/customer/invoice evidence and stores no editable receivable balance
recommendation is immutable evidence and never changes receivable
write-off authorisation is separately permissioned and revalidates against current invoice outstanding
active write-off reduces operational receivable without mutating invoice, credit-note or payment history
write-off reversal is additive and restores receivable
recovery consumes capacity from an existing non-reversed same-currency payment receipt but does not reopen customer receivable
recovery reversal restores payment capacity only
active recovery must be reversed before source write-off or source payment reversal
invoice bad-debt mutation lock order is customer -> invoice -> bad-debt evidence
historical statements show write-off credits and reversal debits at real event times; recovery is not a customer receivable movement

database_types.composition: DatabaseSchema = CoreDB & CollectionsDB; Database and DatabaseExecutor both use DatabaseSchema

validation.generated_kysely_drift: zero across core + collections outputs required
validation.status: final documentation-synchronised Package 004J head must prove the complete gate before merge

next_boundary.name: Controlled Tax Relief and Accounting Posting Evidence
recommended_sequence: inspect existing Package 004 tax/accounting structures before adding any new ledger facts
define explicit VAT/tax bad-debt relief evidence independently from operational write-off evidence
define posting/export events without mutating operational invoice/payment/write-off facts
make every accounting correction additive through reversing evidence
keep bank reconciliation and FX as separate later boundaries
next_boundary.governing_rule: tax relief and accounting posting must be explicit auditable facts linked to operational source evidence; they must not rewrite the invoice, payment or write-off history
